stories.title: Echoes of the Broken Oath
stories.description: POV: You're lost in a kingdom that forgot its gods. Survival is the only magic left. ⚔️💀 #darkfantasy #grimdark #wasteland

scenes.visual_prompt: Extreme close-up, wide cinematic scene of a rusted, cracked gauntlet covered in dried blood, slowly clenching a hilt of a broken sword. First 1–2 seconds: sudden fast camera push-in (zoom shock) into the jagged edge of the broken blade, reflecting a single, flickering torchlight. Then motion stabilizes into a subtle, desperate tremble of the gauntlet. Gritty textures, deep shadows, cinematic macro, 720p.
scenes.visual_reference: HOOK: Immediate, visceral zoom. Focus on a single, grim detail. The trembling gauntlet conveys desperation and struggle instantly.

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide cinematic shot of a desolate, wind-swept wasteland dotted with skeletal trees and the crumbling ruins of colossal, forgotten statues. A perpetual, suffocating dust storm churns in the distance. Camera: slow steady dolly across the bleak landscape, emphasizing the vast emptiness, volumetric dust, muted color palette, epic scale, 720p.
scenes.visual_reference: Context: Establish the 'grimdark' world. Show the desolation and ancient ruin, hinting at a lost, grander past. The dust storm adds constant, uneasy motion.

scenes.visual_prompt: A cinematic shot of a lone, cloaked figure traversing a treacherous, narrow mountain pass under a blood-red sky. They clutch a dim, flickering lantern. A colossal, shadowy beast's eyes briefly glow from the crags above. Camera: slow controlled movement following the figure, emphasizing their vulnerability against the immense backdrop, high contrast, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, 720p.
scenes.visual_reference: Example: Focus on the struggle for survival. The single light source against overwhelming darkness, with a hint of a lurking threat, defines grimdark tension.

scenes.visual_prompt: A wide cinematic closing shot. The cloaked figure from the previous scene finally reaches a precipice, looking down at a vast, glowing chasm where faint, corrupted magical energy pulses rhythmically, illuminating grotesque, ancient structures below. Camera: slow gentle pull-back, revealing the scale of the chasm and the figure's smallness, eerie green/purple glow, oppressive atmosphere, 720p.
scenes.visual_reference: Final Reveal: End with a sense of unsettling mystery and overwhelming power. The corrupted glow hints at dark magic and a deeper, sinister lore.
